Variants.Content: Entry House Dandiras Outsiders call this the city of mages, talking about blood magic, necromancy and reforging Valyrian steel; but what Dandelas faces daily is still warehousing, lumber, wages, rituals and caravan seasons. Rumors can increase awe, and maintaining family business depends on repeatable order. Located on the edge of the Great Forest, Qohor is known for its blacksmiths who can reforge Valyrian steel, color metal, and the faith of the Black Goat. The city's wealth comes from forests, workshops, caravans and slave labor, while religious sacrifices and industry secrets combine to shape its dark reputation.
Entry Dandiras If a family offends industry secrets or religious authorities, no matter how much money they spend, they may lose their foothold in the city.
Entry Dandiras When outsiders admire colored steel, they rarely think of how many people around the fire inhale smoke and dust all year round.
